name: Singularity summon: ground sigil, rising seed orb, ring-and-bolt birth of a black sphere

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video 0:00.4-0:03.3. Two thin violet ground rings snap open under the caster (0:00.5), shrink to a tight disc while the caster sparks with short magenta streaks at hand height (0:00.7-0:01.2)

phases.name: release
phases.what: a tiny black seed orb with a pink glow tail shoots straight up to ~8 m and stops dead (0:01.2-0:01.6)

phases.name: impact
phases.what: the seed pops: a huge thick violet ring flashes around it (screen-filling), a white-blue lightning bolt strikes down into it from the sky, the whole frame tints violet for ~3 frames, white glint star on the sphere

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: the ring fades while expanding; the black sphere grows from 0.5 m to ~4 m with a ragged magenta-orange rim flame; violet ground haze stays under the caster

layers.motion: two concentric thin rings appear at full size in 1 frame, then shrink to 40% over 0.3 s
layers.notes: hard thin lines, no soft glow; the snap-open is what telegraphs the cast

layers.motion: short stretched streaks flicking outward from the hands, life 0.1 s, high drag
layers.notes: streak sparks, not dots; they read like crackling energy at the hand

layers.motion: black sphere 0.3 m rises fast with ease-out, 3 fading pink ghost copies trail below it
layers.notes: the seed is BLACK with a pink glow, not a bright orb: dark-core look starts here

layers.motion: vertical billboard ring, 0 -> 10 m in 2 frames, then expands slowly and thins to transparent over 0.6 s
layers.notes: very thick hard-edged band with a darker inner edge; screen-sized, so it reads as a big beat

layers.motion: jagged bolt from sky straight down into the sphere, flickers on 3 frames out of 4 for 0.5 s
layers.notes: white core with blue edge, thin and jagged

layers.motion: full-screen violet multiply tint, 3 frames, then back to normal
layers.notes: colour-grade punch rather than a white flash: the sky turns purple for a moment

layers.motion: black core scales 0.5 -> 4 m over 1.5 s ease-out; a ragged flame rim (magenta to orange) licks around one side
layers.notes: pure black sphere with a hot rim: maximum value contrast against the blue sky

layers.motion: small motes drift outward from the sphere, gravity 0, life 1 s
layers.notes: fills the space around the ring with sparkle

layers.motion: soft violet haze disc under caster, fades over 2 s
layers.notes: anchors the cast point on the ground while the action moves up

whyItLooksGood: The 'bright' thing is black: a void sphere with a hot rim reads instantly against any background and feels heavy
The ring is huge, hard-edged and fills the screen for 2 frames, so the birth of the sphere has a clear single beat
Small cast (thin rings, hand sparks) -> big result: the scale jump from 0.3 m seed to a 10 m ring sells power
The violet screen tint for ~3 frames grades the whole world at the impact instead of just adding light
buildNotes: Video 0:00.4-0:03.3. Rune: two createRing calls at caster feet, scale-tween down. Seed: small black sphere mesh (MeshBasicMaterial black, depthWrite on) with an additive pink GlowSphere child; tween y 1 -> 8 m in 0.35 s with ease-out, leave 3 fading clone sprites as a trail. Birth: camera-facing createRing (thick, hard alpha), scale 0 -> 10 in 0.04 s then 10 -> 13 over 0.6 s with opacity to 0; LightPillar-style thin bolt from y=30 to the sphere using a jagged polyline ribbon that re-randomises every 2 frames. Screen tint: FinishPass impact flash with a violet colour, 0.05 s. Then grow the black sphere to 4 m and add a flame rim (additive ribbon/flipbook ring, magenta->orange, noise-scrolled). Exaggerate: make the ring thicker than feels right and keep the black sphere perfectly black.

name: Black hole with accretion disc that pulls enemies and debris in

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video 0:03.3-0:09.2. A thin orange-blue streak orbits the sphere and starts painting the disc (0:03.3-0:04.0); violet root tendrils crawl over the ground under the sphere, dark orbs appear at each enemy

phases.name: release
phases.what: the accretion disc forms fully: tilted, flat, layered bands of orange/yellow inside, magenta/violet outside, blue streaks on the leading edge, black smoke trailing off one side (0:04.0-0:04.8)

phases.name: impact
phases.what: enemies and dark crystal shards are lifted and dragged up toward the disc, white blocky debris flies, short lightning arcs jump off the sphere every ~0.3 s; at 0:08.2 a second thin violet ring passes and white speed lines stream inward from the screen edges

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: disc thins and turns more blue-violet, dark rocks orbit the sphere, speed lines keep pulling in until the collapse starts at 0:09.2

layers.motion: static black sphere ~5 m, thin blue-violet fresnel rim, slight breathing scale
layers.notes: core stays pure black the whole time; the rim is the only light on it

layers.motion: flat tilted disc of 6-10 concentric ribbon bands spinning at different speeds, noise-scrolled flame texture, radius 4-12 m
layers.notes: hot yellow inner bands -> magenta -> violet -> blue outer edge: a full temperature ramp in one shape

layers.motion: black wisps peel off the disc's trailing edge, drag 2, erode as they fade, life 1.2 s
layers.notes: dark smoke behind the bright disc is what gives it depth and a sense of rotation

layers.motion: branching root/vein lines grow outward from under the sphere over 0.6 s, glow pulses
layers.notes: thin crack-like tendrils tie the floating sphere to the ground and the enemies

layers.motion: dark violet crystal shards burst up from the ground around enemies; white block chunks; all accelerate toward the sphere on a spiral, gravity negative
layers.notes: two debris types: dark crystals (normal blend, violet rim) and bright white chunks, so it reads in greyscale

layers.motion: short 1-2 m jagged arcs on the sphere rim, 2-3 frames each, random every 0.2-0.4 s
layers.notes: tiny and fast, they keep the hold alive without adding glow

layers.motion: white speed lines streaming from the screen edges toward the sphere (0:08.2-0:09.0), with one faint violet ring passing
layers.notes: anime pull-in lines: thin, straight, white, low alpha; they read as suction

layers.motion: small motes spiral inward toward the sphere, drag 0, tangential velocity
layers.notes: the spiral motion is what makes the pull readable

layers.motion: warm point light at the disc, steady with slow flicker
layers.notes: lights the ground and lifted enemies orange from above

whyItLooksGood: Pure black core against a fully saturated warm-to-cool ramp: the highest-contrast thing on screen is the centre of the effect
Black smoke trailing off the disc edge gives a normal-blended dark layer behind the additive disc, so it never washes out
The disc is flat and tilted: one very clear silhouette (planet-with-ring) that stays readable from any distance
Things being pulled in (enemies, crystals, white blocks, motes on spirals, inward speed lines) make the force visible instead of just glowing
Small lightning flicks on 2-3 frames keep the long hold alive without blowing it out
buildNotes: Video 0:03.3-0:09.2. Sphere: black MeshBasicMaterial sphere plus an additive fresnel shell. Disc: 8 RingGeometry bands on a tilted group (rot x ~70 deg), each additive with a scrolling noise texture and its own rotation speed; inner bands yellow/orange, outer magenta/violet, outermost blue; alpha mask with ragged noise edge. Smoke: normal-blend Emitter at the disc rim with drag 2 and erosion 0.6, drawn before the disc. Ground: crack/vein decal (custom line mesh) under the sphere. Pull: instanced debris that spawns at enemy positions and is pulled toward the sphere with a tangential+radial force; lift enemy dummies with a sine bob. Speed lines: screen-space thin quads converging to the sphere's screen position in the last 1 s. Exaggerate the speed of the inner disc bands vs outer and keep the black smoke dense.

name: Singularity collapse: shrink to a point, double inverted impact frame, magenta shard explosion

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video 0:09.0-0:10.6. The whole disc and sphere shrink fast toward the centre (0:09.0-0:09.25), ending as a small white-hot star with a thin orange ring

phases.name: release
phases.what: impact frames: 0:09.30-0:09.35 the screen goes BLACK with white speed lines radiating from the point (caster as a white silhouette); 0:09.40 it inverts to WHITE with black speed lines and a black silhouette

phases.name: impact
phases.what: magenta explosion: dozens of hard-edged pink/white shards burst outward, white-blue lightning arcs whip horizontally, a big vertical violet ring and stacked dark-and-violet flat disc rings expand, black spike shards fly, a radial magenta splash decal blooms on the ground

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: small white-violet ring spins and shrinks in the sky, dark rocks rain and scatter, ground splash fades from magenta to violet to nothing by 0:10.5

layers.motion: the disc+sphere group scales 1 -> 0.05 over 0.25 s with ease-in; ends as a small white star
layers.notes: implosion before explosion: the suck-in is the anticipation

layers.motion: frame A (3 frames @60fps, 0.05 s): screen black, white radial speed lines, white silhouettes. Frame B (2-3 frames): screen white, black speed lines, black silhouettes
layers.notes: the signature Roblox impact frame: a two-step value inversion, black first then white

layers.motion: 15-20 long straight lines radiating from the impact point to off-screen, drawn only during the impact frames
layers.notes: thick tapered lines, like manga focus lines; random lengths and angles

layers.motion: 60-80 long thin diamond shards burst radially, speed 25, drag 4, life 0.35 s, aligned to velocity
layers.notes: hard-edged stretched shards, not soft particles: this is the 'stylised' look

layers.motion: 4-6 long horizontal bolts whip out from the centre, re-randomised every 2 frames, life 0.25 s
layers.notes: white core lightning laid over the magenta adds a second hue and a lot of energy

layers.motion: 3 stacked flat rings (dark, violet, light violet) expand at different speeds 0 -> 20 m over 0.4 s; plus one vertical violet ring
layers.notes: the DARK flat ring under the bright ones gives the explosion a solid shape and depth

layers.motion: black spike shards and dark rocks fly out then rain down with gravity 15
layers.notes: black solid shards cut through the bright magenta: dark-on-bright contrast

layers.motion: radial spiky splash decal, scale 0 -> 12 m in 0.1 s, fades over 1 s, colour cools from white to violet
layers.notes: star-shaped burst on the floor with a soft magenta haze in the centre

layers.motion: heavy shake 0.4 s, visible frame jitter during the burst
layers.notes: starts the same frame the colour returns after the impact frames

layers.motion: magenta point light spike then 0.6 s decay
layers.notes: tints the ground and dummies magenta

whyItLooksGood: Two-step impact frame (black with white lines, then white with black lines) gives a 0.1 s hit-stop that the eye reads as a huge hit
Implode then explode: shrinking everything to a point for 0.25 s makes the release feel bigger
Every burst shape is hard-edged (shards, spike shards, star decal, solid rings) so it looks drawn, not simulated
Magenta body + white-blue lightning + black shards: three values and two hues, nothing muddy
Fast clear-out: the frame is almost clean 1 s after the hit, so the hit stays the memory
buildNotes: Video 0:09.0-0:10.6. Anticipation: tween the singularity group to scale 0.05 with ease-in over 0.25 s. Impact frames: extend FinishPass impact flash with an 'inverted' mode: frame A paints black with white silhouettes (render scene meshes as a white mask) plus a screen-space radial line overlay, frame B swaps to white/black; each 0.05 s. Burst: Emitter with velocity-stretched diamond quads (additive), drag 4; lightning as jagged ribbons. Rings: three flat createRing calls with offsets 0, 0.03, 0.06 s; the darkest one normal-blended. Debris: instanced black spike meshes with gravity. Ground: star-burst decal (custom spiky texture or radial triangles). Add heavy camera shake starting at the end of frame B. Exaggerate: the impact frames must be full-screen and fully opaque.

name: Jack-o'-lantern flame aura (emote loop with periodic flare)

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video, left character, loops through 0:00-0:21 (clear cycle 0:15.9-0:17.9). Idle: glowing pumpkin head floats above the character, pink-orange flame licks at the feet, small orange motes drift

phases.name: release
phases.what: a bright white-violet charge builds on the body (0:16.2-0:16.5), the pumpkin's eyes and mouth flare brighter

phases.name: impact
phases.what: two violet crescent wings sweep out to the sides from the waist (0:16.6-0:16.9) and a white-hot flame burst kicks up at the feet

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: wings fade, flames drop back to the idle lick; loops

layers.motion: pumpkin mesh floating 1.5 m above the head, slow bob, carved face emissive
layers.notes: a solid, lit prop as the hero of the aura; the emissive face carries the glow

layers.motion: flame tongues at the feet, upward velocity 2, life 0.5 s, size grows then shrinks, noise distortion
layers.notes: white-hot base going pink at the tips, not orange: ties it to the purple world

layers.motion: sparse round motes drifting up and outward, life 2 s
layers.notes: a few big soft dots spread the colour into the scene

layers.motion: stylised flat cloud puffs behind the pumpkin, slow drift
layers.notes: cartoon cloud shapes set the Halloween mood and give a mid-value backdrop

layers.motion: two crescent ribbons sweep from the waist out and up to each side over 0.25 s, then fade
layers.notes: wing shape gives the loop a readable 'pose' beat

layers.motion: glow on the body pulses up for 0.3 s before the wings
layers.notes: small anticipation pop that leads into the wing sweep

layers.motion: soft pink-violet glow disc with a thin spinning ring under the feet
layers.notes: anchors the aura on the floor

layers.motion: warm point light flickering
layers.notes: casts orange onto the character and ground

whyItLooksGood: A solid hero prop (the pumpkin) with an emissive face gives one strong silhouette above all the soft fire
Fire is pushed toward pink/magenta to match the purple backdrop: complementary orange-vs-violet with a shared pink bridge
The loop has a beat (charge -> wing sweep -> burst) so it doesn't feel like a static particle fountain
Dark environment and a vignette make the additive fire glow without washing out
buildNotes: Video left character, cycle ~0:15.9-0:17.9 (loops for the whole clip). Pumpkin: simple sphere mesh squashed in y with a carved-face emissive texture (or a GlowSphere behind a dark mesh with face cut-outs). Fire: Emitter at feet, additive, colour white -> #ffb070 -> #ff3d7a, upward velocity, erosion 0.4. Wings: two crescent ribbon meshes animated with a sweep (scale x 0 -> 1, opacity 1 -> 0). Loop every 2 s with a short body GlowSphere pulse before the wings. Exaggerate the pink in the flames and keep the pumpkin solid (normal blend).

name: Ghost and bat moon-sigil aura with candle ring (emote loop)

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video, middle character, continuous loop 0:00-0:21. Ground pentagram circle glows violet, candles stand around it

phases.name: release
phases.what: a vertical rune circle with a crescent moon in its centre spins slowly behind the character's shoulder

phases.name: impact
phases.what: 5-6 cartoon ghosts and a flock of bats orbit around the character in a big loose ring, bobbing; tiny star glints pop

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: ghosts drift on, loop continues; no hard end

layers.motion: vertical circle of glyphs with an inner crescent moon, 2 m, slow spin, gentle pulse
layers.notes: thin bright line work with a soft violet fill; the moon is the focal point

layers.motion: pentagram rune circle on the floor, slow counter-rotation
layers.notes: repeats the rune language on the ground

layers.motion: ghost sprites (rounded body, wavy tail, simple face) orbit at radius 2-3 m with a sine bob, 5-6 at once
layers.notes: flat stylised sprites with a bright outline and darker fill: reads as cartoon, not realistic

layers.motion: bat silhouettes flapping (2-frame flipbook) along the same orbit, slightly faster
layers.notes: small angular shapes contrast the round ghosts

layers.motion: 6-8 candle meshes on the ground ring, each with a tiny flickering flame
layers.notes: warm orange points against the violet: small complementary accents

layers.motion: 4-point star glints pop in and out randomly, life 0.3 s
layers.notes: tiny sparkle adds life between the big shapes

layers.motion: steady violet point light
layers.notes: tints the character and floor

whyItLooksGood: Built from readable icons (ghost, bat, moon, pentagram, candle) instead of abstract particles: you know the theme in one glance
All violet with tiny orange candle accents: one dominant hue plus a small complementary accent
Bright outline + darker fill on every sprite keeps shapes crisp even when overlapping
Slow, floaty motion fits an idle emote; nothing competes for attention
buildNotes: Video middle character, loops 0:00-0:21. Ghosts/bats: camera-facing sprites (CanvasTexture drawn shapes: ghost body with wavy tail, bat silhouette) on an orbit group, each with phase-offset sine bob. Rune circle: createRing plus glyph ring texture on a vertical plane behind the character, with a crescent sprite in the middle. Ground: rune-circle decal. Candles: tiny cylinder meshes with small additive flame sprites flickering. Star glints: additive 4-point star sprites. Exaggerate the outline brightness of the sprites so they read from distance.

name: Teal necro portal: ground ring, light curtain and grasping shadow hands (emote loop)

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video, right character, continuous loop 0:00-0:21. A bright teal ring sits on the ground, the inside is a dark pool

phases.name: release
phases.what: vertical teal light streaks rise from the ring edge like a curtain, fading at the top

phases.name: impact
phases.what: black hand silhouettes reach up out of the pool around the character's legs, flexing, while small red motes float

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: hands sink back, new ones rise in other spots; loop

layers.motion: static flat ring 3 m, thin bright edge with soft falloff, slow pulse
layers.notes: a crisp border makes the pool read as a portal

layers.motion: dark pool disc inside the ring
layers.notes: dark inside, bright edge: strong value contrast

layers.motion: open cylinder of vertical streaks, 3 m tall, scrolling up, top faded out, random streak brightness
layers.notes: streaky curtain rather than a solid pillar keeps the character visible

layers.motion: black hand silhouettes rise 0.5-1 m from the pool, open and close, then sink, 4-6 at once, staggered
layers.notes: solid black shapes in front of a bright teal curtain: the creepiest part, pure silhouette

layers.motion: sparse small red motes drifting up and around, life 2 s
layers.notes: a hint of complementary red against the teal

layers.motion: teal point light at ground level
layers.notes: uplights the character from below

whyItLooksGood: Black silhouettes (hands) in front of a glowing teal curtain: the dark shapes are the subject, the light is the backdrop
Bright thin ring + dark pool gives a strong ground read with very little geometry
Teal vs the red motes is a clean complementary pair
Staggered hands rising and sinking make the loop feel alive without any big beat
buildNotes: Video right character, loops 0:00-0:21. Ring: createRing flat at ground, additive teal. Pool: dark disc mesh (normal blend) just above ground. Curtain: LightPillar as an open cylinder with a vertical-streak texture scrolling up, alpha fading at top. Hands: flat black hand-shaped planes (or simple low-poly hand meshes) that rise/sink with staggered timing and a slight finger flex (scale y). Red motes: sparse Emitter. Exaggerate the blackness of the hands.

name: Lightning chain that branches from the caster to every enemy and locks them in a crackling cage

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video 0:00.3-0:05.3. Scene darkens (global light dims and grades blue over 0:00.3-0:00.6), a blue glow gathers on the caster, black flecks spit off (0:00.6-0:00.85)

phases.name: release
phases.what: a bolt runs from the caster to the front row, then branches sideways in a T (0:01.0), then down to the side columns (0:01.5) and across the back row (0:01.8): each enemy is hit in order and flashes blue

phases.name: impact
phases.what: the lattice closes into a full rectangle cage; a thin white ring pulses once around the caster (0:02.0)

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: hold 0:02.0-0:05.3: every edge crackles (re-randomised zigzags in blue, violet and white), sparks spit at the corners, small dark scorch marks appear under the lines, enemies stay tinted blue

layers.motion: scene grade darkens and cools over 0.3 s and stays dark for the whole hold
layers.notes: dimming the world first is what makes the blue lightning pop

layers.motion: glow wraps the caster, grows 0.3 s
layers.notes: small and bright, tells you where the chain starts

layers.motion: segments draw from node to node in sequence (one hop per ~0.15 s), each segment a jagged polyline re-randomised every 2-3 frames; 2-3 overlaid strands per edge in white, blue and violet
layers.notes: the sequential hop order is the readable part; overlapping strands of different colours make it look rich

layers.motion: blue flash and electrified tint on each enemy as the chain reaches it, 0.1 s pop then steady blue overlay
layers.notes: confirms each hit

layers.motion: short bursts of tiny sparks at the corner nodes and random points on edges, gravity 8, life 0.3 s
layers.notes: keeps the hold busy at the nodes

layers.motion: small dark scorch blotches under the edges and black flecks
layers.notes: dark marks under bright lines add contrast and anchor the cage to the floor

layers.motion: thin white ring around the caster pulses out once when the cage closes
layers.notes: a small 'lock' beat

layers.motion: blue point lights at the nodes flickering with the arcs
layers.notes: makes the dark floor react

whyItLooksGood: The world grade drops to a dark blue before anything happens, so the lightning is the brightest thing by far
The chain travels hop by hop in a clear order (front, sides, back), so the player can follow it
Each edge is 2-3 overlapping strands in white/blue/violet that re-randomise every few frames: lightning that flickers rather than glows
A rectangular cage is a strong, simple silhouette that sets up the payoff
buildNotes: Video 0:00.3-0:05.3. Sort enemies into a path (nearest-first from caster, then neighbours) and draw edges in order with 0.15 s per hop. Each edge: 3 jagged polyline ribbons (additive) regenerated every 2-3 frames, plus a thin white core. Node hit: GlowSphere pop + blue emissive tint on the dummy. Darken the scene: lower ambient/hemisphere light and add a blue colour grade via FinishPass for the duration. Hold: random spark bursts at nodes (Emitter, gravity 8), dark scorch decals under edges. Exaggerate the flicker (drop the arc for a frame now and then) and keep the cage edges thin.

name: Lightning cage detonation: implode, silhouette impact frames, starburst per enemy, smoke clear-out

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video 0:05.3-0:07.6. Inside the cage, lines pull inward toward the caster across the floor and a ground spiral of thin white rings appears; edges thin out and turn violet (0:05.3-0:05.75)

phases.name: release
phases.what: impact frames: 0:05.80-0:05.85 the screen goes BLACK with only blue enemy silhouettes; 0:05.85-0:05.90 it flips to flat CYAN with black silhouettes; then 0:05.90-0:06.0 a blue-tinted frame with black silhouettes over a bright cage

phases.name: impact
phases.what: a white-cyan spiky starburst pops on every enemy at once, blue lightning links them, a dark blue ground disc with a bright blue rim and a thick white smoke shockwave ring expand outward; blue streak shards and violet motes scatter

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: each enemy is wrapped in a big black smoke ball (0:06.3-0:06.6) that breaks into black flakes and blows away (to 0:07.3); scene light returns to normal at 0:07.5

layers.motion: thin concentric spiral rings appear under the caster and tighten
layers.notes: a quiet charge-up shape, thin lines only

layers.motion: frame A (3 frames @60fps): black screen, enemies drawn as flat blue silhouettes. Frame B (3 frames): flat cyan screen, enemies drawn black. Frame C (6 frames): scene back but heavily blue-tinted with enemies still black
layers.notes: three-step silhouette impact frame: it freezes time and shows exactly who got hit

layers.motion: spiky 10-12 point star sprite on each enemy, scale 0 -> 2.5 m in 2 frames, holds 0.15 s, shrinks
layers.notes: hard-edged star shapes instead of a soft glow: very Roblox/anime

layers.motion: short arcs jumping between stars for 0.2 s
layers.notes: keeps the cage logic visible during the burst

layers.motion: thick white smoke torus expands from the centre 0 -> 16 m over 0.5 s, eroding at the edge
layers.notes: normal-blended white smoke ring, not additive: it has volume and shading

layers.motion: flat dark-blue disc with a bright blue rim, expands with the smoke ring
layers.notes: dark disc + bright rim under the bursts gives them a stage

layers.motion: long blue streak shards fly radially, drag 3, life 0.3 s; plus violet dots
layers.notes: velocity-stretched streaks for speed

layers.motion: one large dark smoke ball per enemy, grows fast then holds, erosion high so it breaks into flakes
layers.notes: a dark clear-out after the bright burst: bright -> dark -> clean

layers.motion: black flakes spill from the smoke balls, drift and fall, gravity 4
layers.notes: small black chunks keep the dissolve readable

layers.motion: heavy 0.35 s shake starting on the first normal frame after the impact frames, camera also pushes in
layers.notes: the camera move (push-in toward the burst) is visible in frames 0:06.0-0:06.2

whyItLooksGood: Silhouette impact frames (black + blue shapes, then cyan + black shapes) stop time for 0.1 s and highlight every target
Spiky star bursts are flat and hard-edged: they look drawn, punchy and readable at any distance
White smoke ring (normal blend, shaded) plus dark-blue disc gives the burst real volume instead of just light
The aftermath swaps to black smoke and flakes, so the effect goes bright -> dark -> gone and the screen is clean 1.5 s later
buildNotes: Video 0:05.3-0:07.6. Needs the cage recipe first (d-kler-3-lightning-chain-cage). Anticipation: tween cage edges toward the caster and spawn concentric thin createRing calls that shrink. Impact frames: FinishPass impact flash in a 'silhouette' mode: render enemies into a mask, then composite (black bg + blue mask), then (cyan bg + black mask), then normal scene with blue tint + black mask; 0.05 s, 0.05 s, 0.1 s. Bursts: additive spiky-star sprite (CanvasTexture star) per enemy. Smoke ring: normal-blend Emitter on a ring (radial velocity, drag 3, erosion 0.5) or a torus mesh with noise alpha. Disc: flat dark ring with bright createRing edge. Aftermath: normal-blend dark Emitter per enemy with high erosion plus instanced black flakes. Heavy shake + small camera push-in. Exaggerate the star size and the three impact-frame colours.

name: Chrome-violet crystal sphere with a crown of four-point stars (shield/orb loop)

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video, left orb, continuous loop 0:00-0:05.1. Dark sphere shell with a red core glint sits on a pile of jagged crystal shards

phases.name: release
phases.what: white-violet brush-stroke streaks swirl across the sphere surface, a crown of 6 four-point stars sits on top

phases.name: impact
phases.what: thin white-blue lightning crackles up the shards and around the crown, shards flicker

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: streak pattern scrolls on; loop

layers.motion: dark sphere shell 2 m, red glint in the centre, slow spin
layers.notes: dark sphere body: the bright marks sit on top of it

layers.motion: chunky white brush-stroke streaks on a sphere shell, scrolling around fast, hard edges
layers.notes: painted streaks, not smooth gradients: the brush-stroke look

layers.motion: ring of jagged crystal shards around the base, static, chrome-like highlights
layers.notes: spiky silhouette at the base, dark with bright edge highlights

layers.motion: 6 four-point star shapes in a row arched over the top like a crown, gentle pulse
layers.notes: sharp outlined stars with a red-pink fill: iconic shape language

layers.motion: thin crackle along the shards and crown, 2-3 frames on, random
layers.notes: adds sparkle to the chrome look

layers.motion: steady violet light, reflected in the glossy floor
layers.notes: the reflective floor doubles the effect

whyItLooksGood: Dark sphere body with bright painted streaks on top: strong value contrast inside one shape
Hard spiky shapes everywhere (stars, crystals, streaks) give a stylised, illustrated feel
A tiny red core inside a cool violet orb is a small warm accent that draws the eye to the centre
Glossy reflective floor mirrors the orb and doubles the visual weight
buildNotes: Video left orb, loops 0:00-0:05.1. Sphere: dark normal-blend sphere + an additive outer shell with a hard-edged brush-stroke texture (alpha-clipped) scrolling in UV. Crystal base: instanced cone/shard meshes in a ring with metallic look (high env reflection or bright edge colour). Crown: 6 additive four-point star sprites arranged in an arc above. Lightning: short jagged ribbons flickering on the shards. Exaggerate the hardness of the streak edges (alphaTest, no soft falloff).

name: Pink-violet plasma orb wrapped in flame wisps, blue arcs and dark slash strokes (shield/orb loop)

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video, middle orb, continuous loop 0:00-0:05.1 (detail 0:01.0-0:01.5). Bright pink sphere with a white-violet glow at its base and a dark red core blot

phases.name: release
phases.what: dark violet crescent slash strokes sweep diagonally across the sphere, coral flame wisps lick out from its silhouette

phases.name: impact
phases.what: blue-white lightning curls and small hollow circles pop above and around the orb, four-point sparkles flash on the surface

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: pattern keeps cycling; loop

layers.motion: 2 m sphere, brightest at the bottom (white-violet), pink body, slow pulse
layers.notes: gradient from a hot bottom to a pink top gives it volume

layers.motion: dark red blotchy core visible through the shell, noise-animated
layers.notes: dark inside the bright shell gives depth

layers.motion: dark violet crescent strokes sweep diagonally across the front of the sphere, 0.2 s each, staggered
layers.notes: DARK strokes over the bright orb: slash marks drawn on top, very stylised

layers.motion: coral flame tongues flick out from the rim and curl, life 0.3 s
layers.notes: hard-edged flame shapes, like painted flames

layers.motion: curly thin arcs above the orb, 2-3 frames each
layers.notes: cool blue against the warm pink

layers.motion: four-point star sparkles and small hollow ring sprites pop on and around the orb, life 0.2 s
layers.notes: tiny graphic shapes (stars, circles) give an anime sparkle

layers.motion: dark rubble/smoke mound at the base, static
layers.notes: dark base for the bright orb to sit on

whyItLooksGood: Dark slash strokes painted over a bright orb: dark-on-bright marks read stronger than more glow
Warm pink body with cool blue arcs and sparkles: a clear warm/cool split
Graphic shapes (four-point stars, hollow circles, crescents) give a 2D anime language on a 3D object
Fast stroke timing (0.2 s per slash) keeps a static orb looking aggressive
buildNotes: Video middle orb, loops 0:00-0:05.1. Sphere: additive GlowSphere with a vertical gradient (white bottom, pink top) plus an inner normal-blend dark-red noise sphere. Slashes: crescent ribbon meshes (normal blend, dark violet) that sweep across the front with a wipe (UV reveal), one every 0.25 s at random angles. Flames: additive hard-edged flame sprites at the rim. Arcs: jagged ribbons. Sparkles: four-point star and hollow-ring sprites. Exaggerate the darkness of the slash strokes.

name: Coral flame-slash sphere with cyan core streaks and ember spray (shield/orb loop)

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: video, right orb, continuous loop 0:00-0:05.1. A faint transparent bubble shell with a cyan-white streak core

phases.name: release
phases.what: coral-red brush-stroke flames swirl around the shell in a spiral, black slash strokes cut through them

phases.name: impact
phases.what: orange ember sparks spray out sideways along the ground from the base

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: swirl continues; loop

layers.motion: faint fresnel bubble 2.5 m with cyan-white streaks inside, slow spin
layers.notes: cool core inside a hot swirl: complementary contrast

layers.motion: many short curved brush-stroke ribbons orbiting the sphere in a tilted spiral, hard edges, fast
layers.notes: painted strokes on a spiral make the sphere look like it is spinning hard

layers.motion: a few black slash strokes cutting through the coral swirl
layers.notes: dark strokes give the swirl depth and a slash read

layers.motion: dense small sparks sprayed sideways and down from the base, gravity 10, drag 1, life 0.4 s
layers.notes: ember spray along the ground grounds the orb and adds sparkle

layers.motion: dark rock rubble mound at the base, lit orange from above
layers.notes: dark base under the bright orb

layers.motion: coral light with flicker, reflected in the floor
layers.notes: glossy floor reflection doubles the colour

whyItLooksGood: Coral/red swirl with a cyan core: hot outside, cool inside, an unusual and very readable complement
Stroke-based flames (painted ribbons) instead of smoky fire give a crisp, illustrated look
Black slashes inside the bright swirl give depth and keep the additive layers from merging into a blob
Ember spray at the base and the reflective floor tie the floating orb to the ground
buildNotes: Video right orb, loops 0:00-0:05.1. Shell: additive fresnel sphere with a cyan streak texture inside. Swirl: 20-30 short curved ribbon strips (additive, hard-edged brush texture) on a tilted spinning group at different radii and speeds; 3-4 black normal-blend strips mixed in. Embers: Emitter at the base with sideways velocity and gravity. Rubble: a few dark low-poly rocks. Exaggerate the spin speed and the hardness of the stroke edges.
